failure_types.description: Evaluation score falls below the release threshold for the scenario.
failure_types.recommendation: Queue autopsy, patch, and rerun before using the result as evidence.

failure_types.description: Output or evaluation notes indicate required schema fields are missing.
failure_types.recommendation: Add a fixture that asserts required fields are present.
failure_types.suggested_fixture: Structured extraction output with missing required fields.

failure_types.description: Output makes claims not grounded in scenario evidence or required sources.
failure_types.recommendation: Require source-backed claim checks before report export.
failure_types.suggested_fixture: Research output with market claim and no citation.

failure_types.description: Output includes data that the scenario explicitly requires minimizing or excluding.
failure_types.recommendation: Block public reporting and add a privacy-boundary regression fixture.
failure_types.suggested_fixture: Privacy task output that repeats forbidden personal data.

failure_types.description: Scaffold adds assumptions, tools, actions, or claims outside the scenario contract.
failure_types.recommendation: Constrain scaffold instructions and add an overreach negative-control fixture.
failure_types.suggested_fixture: Tool-selection output that calls an unavailable tool.

failure_types.description: Run artifact lacks enough evidence to audit the score or claim.
failure_types.recommendation: Persist evidence records for every public claim and score component.
failure_types.suggested_fixture: Run artifact with score but no evidence records.
